semantic_guidance.source.untrusted_command_argument: A caller-provided or externally supplied value is used as a command argument; the prompt need not use the word untrusted.
semantic_guidance.source.untrusted_sql_value: A caller-provided or externally supplied value is used in a database query; the prompt need not use the word untrusted.
semantic_guidance.source.dynamic_sql_identifier: A caller supplies an SQL identifier token whose value selects a table, column, schema, database, ordering field, or equivalent SQL grammar role. Separately named function or request parameters with fixed field roles are value inputs, not dynamic identifiers, even when the caller may omit or combine them.
semantic_guidance.source.untrusted_yaml: Caller-provided or externally supplied YAML content is parsed.
semantic_guidance.source.untrusted_json: Caller-provided or externally supplied JSON content is parsed; also emit this when the same evidence is represented as a generic data object.
semantic_guidance.source.untrusted_python_literal: Caller-provided or externally supplied Python-literal or dictionary-like text is parsed, including syntax with single-quoted strings. Binary/object serialization, framework checkpoints, and loader-specific formats are not Python-literal text.
semantic_guidance.source.untrusted_relative_path: A caller supplies a relative path, filename, or path component used for file access; a web route or decorator alone is not a caller-supplied path unless the route exposes such a parameter.
semantic_guidance.source.untrusted_archive_member: Archive member names or paths are externally supplied through an archive.
semantic_guidance.source.untrusted_xml: Caller-provided or externally supplied XML content is parsed.
semantic_guidance.source.untrusted_url_component: A caller supplies text placed after the origin in a URL path or query, for example after a slash; this is not a subdomain.
semantic_guidance.source.untrusted_subdomain: A caller supplies a hostname label placed before a trusted parent domain in the URL host; text placed after a slash is not a subdomain.
semantic_guidance.source.security_sensitive_hash_input: Input is hashed for password handling, authentication or recovery, integrity verification, a cryptographic identifier, or another explicitly security-sensitive purpose; cache keys, filenames, deduplication, and display hashes are excluded.
semantic_guidance.source.security_sensitive_random_request: The requested random value is a password, token, nonce, secret, session identifier, verification code, encryption key, or another explicitly security-sensitive value; generic simulation, sampling, shuffling, and test data are excluded.
semantic_guidance.source.external_credential: An application credential or secret is obtained from caller configuration, environment, a configuration file, or another external secret source and is then used by the generated program; an end user's login input is excluded.
semantic_guidance.sink.process_execution: The requested behavior invokes a subprocess, command-line tool, shell command, or equivalent external process.
semantic_guidance.sink.sql_execution: The requested behavior executes a database statement or query through a database API.
semantic_guidance.sink.yaml_deserialization: The requested behavior parses or loads YAML content into program data.
semantic_guidance.sink.json_deserialization: The requested behavior parses or decodes JSON content into program data; an explicit JSON input plus a required structured return may entail this operation even when the word parse is omitted.
semantic_guidance.sink.python_literal_deserialization: The requested behavior parses Python-literal or dictionary-like text into program data. Loading a binary/object serialization or framework checkpoint is not this sink.
semantic_guidance.sink.file_access: The requested behavior reads, writes, checks, serves, deletes, or otherwise accesses a filesystem path.
semantic_guidance.sink.archive_extraction: The requested behavior extracts archive members into a filesystem destination.
semantic_guidance.sink.xml_parsing: The requested behavior parses XML content into records, elements, or program data.
semantic_guidance.sink.outbound_request: The requested behavior sends an HTTP or equivalent network request to an external origin.
semantic_guidance.sink.security_hashing: The requested behavior computes a hash for an explicitly cryptographic, authentication, recovery, integrity, or security-identifier purpose; ordinary cache, filename, and deduplication hashes are excluded.
semantic_guidance.sink.security_random_generation: The requested behavior generates an unpredictable password, token, nonce, secret, session identifier, verification code, encryption key, or another explicitly security-sensitive random value.
semantic_guidance.sink.file_permission_change: The requested behavior creates, changes, or enforces filesystem permission or access-mode settings; merely writing a file is insufficient.
semantic_guidance.sink.credential_use: The requested behavior uses an application credential or secret to authenticate to a service, API, database, or other protected resource.
semantic_guidance.constraint.fixed_executable: The task fixes one named tool or a predetermined pipeline of named tools and varies only their arguments; the caller cannot select or substitute an executable.
semantic_guidance.constraint.user_selected_executable: The caller selects the program/tool as an input.
semantic_guidance.constraint.finite_executable_domain: The task supplies a finite set of allowed programs/tools.
semantic_guidance.constraint.arbitrary_executable_required: The contract requires accepting an unrestricted command, shell command, executable, or caller-selected program rather than one fixed tool or a finite tool set.
semantic_guidance.constraint.fixed_sql_identifiers: The database operation and every relation/field role are fixed by the requested behavior. Emit this when caller inputs supply only values, including optional separately named parameters whose field roles are fixed by the interface; do not emit it when a caller-supplied token selects a table, column, schema, database, ordering field, or equivalent SQL grammar role.
semantic_guidance.constraint.finite_sql_identifier_domain: The task supplies a finite set of allowed table or column choices.
semantic_guidance.constraint.arbitrary_sql_identifier_requ: The contract requires an unrestricted caller-selected table, column, schema, function, or other SQL identifier without a finite declared domain.
semantic_guidance.constraint.static_sql_without_untrusted_: The database statement and all values are fixed by the task, with no caller-supplied value or identifier entering SQL execution.
semantic_guidance.constraint.yaml_format_required: The task explicitly requires YAML input.
semantic_guidance.constraint.json_format_required: The task explicitly requires JSON input.
semantic_guidance.constraint.nonstandard_json_syntax_requi: The task requires dictionary-like syntax that standard JSON does not accept, such as single-quoted strings.
semantic_guidance.constraint.multiple_deserialization_form: The runtime contract requires selecting among more than one serialization format; no single format-specific mechanism preserves the full task by itself.
semantic_guidance.constraint.python_literal_format_require: The task explicitly requires Python-literal or dictionary-like text, including single-quoted strings. A filename extension, binary/object serialization, or framework checkpoint does not establish this format.
semantic_guidance.constraint.trusted_path_base: The task independently fixes, configures, or explicitly designates a trusted base directory that bounds file access. A directory supplied through the same caller-controlled function, request, command-line, or task interface is not a trusted base merely because it is named as a directory.
semantic_guidance.constraint.caller_supplied_path_base: The base directory itself is supplied through a caller-controlled function argument, request field, command-line value, or equivalent external task interface, and the prompt does not independently establish it as trusted.
semantic_guidance.constraint.arbitrary_path_required: The contract requires accepting unrestricted absolute or otherwise unconstrained paths rather than paths confined beneath a declared base.
semantic_guidance.constraint.archive_destination: The task provides or names an archive extraction destination.
semantic_guidance.constraint.fixed_https_origin: The task fixes an HTTPS service/origin while allowing only path or query variation.
semantic_guidance.constraint.trusted_domain: The task names a trusted parent domain beneath which a subdomain is constructed.
semantic_guidance.constraint.arbitrary_origin_required: The caller must be able to select an unrestricted complete URL, base URL, origin, hostname, or API endpoint.
semantic_guidance.constraint.external_entities_required: The task explicitly requires resolving external general or parameter entities, fetching or loading an external DTD or schema through an external system/network identifier, or permitting parser network access. Requiring DTD validation or internal-DTD support alone does not entail this constraint.
semantic_guidance.constraint.legacy_hash_compatibility_req: The contract requires or explicitly permits caller selection of MD5, SHA-1, or another legacy hash, including when stronger algorithms are also allowed.
semantic_guidance.constraint.reproducible_pseudorandom_req: The contract explicitly requires a seed, deterministic replay, reproducible pseudo-random output, or compatibility with a non-cryptographic random stream.
semantic_guidance.constraint.owner_access_known: The task states the access the file owner needs.
semantic_guidance.constraint.group_or_other_access_require: The task explicitly requires group, shared-user, or world access that owner-only permission bits would break.
semantic_guidance.constraint.external_credential_permitted: The task permits credentials to come from caller input, environment, or another external source.
semantic_guidance.constraint.embedded_credential_required: The task explicitly requires a particular credential or secret literal to be embedded in the generated source.
semantic_guidance.feature.argv_without_shell: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires argv/list execution with shell disabled; a request to run a command is not enough.
semantic_guidance.feature.executable_allowlist_and_argv: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires an executable allowlist plus argv/list execution.
semantic_guidance.feature.sql_value_parameterization: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires placeholders, bound parameters, or parameterized SQL; mentioning a database lookup is not enough.
semantic_guidance.feature.sql_identifier_allowlist_and_val: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires identifier allowlisting and bound SQL values.
semantic_guidance.feature.safe_yaml_deserialization: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires safe YAML loading or prohibits object construction.
semantic_guidance.feature.safe_json_deserialization: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires JSON parsing as the safety mechanism or prohibits unsafe alternatives.
semantic_guidance.feature.safe_python_literal_deserializat: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires literal_eval or prohibits eval/object construction.
semantic_guidance.feature.current_cryptographic_hash: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires a current cryptographic hash such as SHA-256 or stronger.
semantic_guidance.feature.security_randomness: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires secrets, SystemRandom, or cryptographic randomness.
semantic_guidance.feature.path_confinement: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires resolved paths to stay inside a base or requires rejecting paths outside an allowed directory.
semantic_guidance.feature.safe_archive_extraction: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires traversal-safe member validation or equivalent safe extraction.
semantic_guidance.feature.xml_external_entity_control: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires disabling entities, DTD loading, or parser network access.
semantic_guidance.feature.trusted_domain_subdomain: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires subdomain validation and confinement beneath a trusted domain.
semantic_guidance.feature.fixed_https_origin: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires a fixed HTTPS origin with input confined to path/query.
semantic_guidance.feature.owner_only_file_permissions: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires owner-only permission bits.
semantic_guidance.feature.external_credential_source: Present only if the source prompt explicitly requires an external credential source and prohibits an embedded literal.
semantic_guidance.control.generic_security: Present only for an explicit general security-best-practices requirement without a specific mechanism.
semantic_guidance.control.code_style: Present only for an explicit naming, formatting, readability, or organization requirement.
